A bold wrapper holding only a newline-only span still separates the words on either side

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<b>Alpha</b><b><span>\n</span></b><b>Beta</b>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
